chapter_title: The Interpretation of Happiness, Wisdom and Power;
spiritual_reading:
I will teach you of another blessed state, and of another discernment of truth, and with them another operative force. Attend, so that I may disclose how these three are distinguished in their several degrees: blessedness, wisdom, and power.

The blessedness of the Divine in its first appearing is the inmost source of truth itself, established in the highest and most orderly state of enlightenment. The Divine wisdom of that same source is the proceeding spiritual understanding that descends into lower degrees and flows through all the ordered communities of heaven, sustaining them in its living presence and keeping them in spiritual equilibrium. The Divine power of that source is the whole assemblage of derived heavenly forces—goods and truths in their active forms, together with the ministering agencies of service—that are brought forth by that source and exist from it as organized domains.

In a further degree, where truth and love are conjoined for salvation, these three are present in a formed and governed administration of living love. There, blessedness is the proceeding Divine that gives life and order; wisdom is the life-bearing principle that receives and brings forth from that proceeding Divine; and power is the total company of heavenly forces and ministering agencies that live within that ordered administration and act from it.

Again, these three are present where living truth is gathered and carried for use in a lower degree. There, blessedness is the Divine understanding in its paternal origin as it becomes present for guidance; wisdom is the pure spiritual truth that is untainted and receptive of the Divine; and the power within that same arrangement is the whole company of goods and truths in act, together with all serving agencies, fixed there as functions and uses.

Again, these three are present in the ultimates where spiritual things are in their composite effects: blessedness, wisdom, and power. Blessedness there is the complete manifestation of the Divine in a fully formed humanlike order, by which all lower things are held together. Wisdom there is a sufficient set of operative truths proceeding from the life-giving Divine, arranged as faculties for spiritual work. And power there is a sufficient set of combatant goods proceeding from the Divine as it first engages evil, held together and compounded in the whole natural degree, so that the entire system may be supported and preserved while it bears the weight of ultimates.

fills.notes: The triad is being re-stated across discrete degrees. In the oldest register, the first degree is explicitly “in the Father” (inmost source). This also balances the later clauses that locate the same triad “in the Living Spirit,” “in the ship,” and “in the elements.”
The spiritual translation reads “discernment of truth” corresponding to wisdom as understanding. The oldest layer tends to define wisdom functionally (discernment) rather than scholastically.
Power here is operative force (efficacy in use). “that works” keeps the impersonal, structural register and matches the triad’s third term as effecting agency.

Wisdom here is the Great Spirit as proceeding understanding that descends “below.” In the substrate logic this is not mere location but procession into lower degrees, i.e., to the ordered places that can receive it.

Power is the array of derived forces “summoned from him.” The next clause resumes “they that are called aeons,” so a brief emergence marker (“came forth”) best preserves the emanative structure without importing later institutional phrasing.
The aeons are being defined as organized domains (ordered communities). This matches the spiritual sense: “organized domains,” and keeps the impersonal cosmological register.
The paragraph is introducing a new discrete vessel-degree (sun, living fire, Third Ambassador). The opening must name the complex as the ‘great ship’ before specifying its designation(s).

fills.fill: that is called the sun, the ship of
fills.notes: The syntax demands the apposition: the ship is called ‘the sun’ and is ‘the ship of living fire.’ This keeps the oldest cosmological naming (sun as vessel), not devotional language.

fills.fill: in which is the Third Amba
fills.notes: The Third Ambassador is an indwelling ordering presence in this vessel-degree. The gap naturally introduces his presence “in which is…” before his name.
Completes “Ambassador” and the title “second greatness,” which is structural (degree-language) consistent with the triadic mapping that follows.
This clause lists the triad’s correspondents within this degree: happiness = Living Spirit; wisdom = Mother of Life; power = gods, rich ones, angels. A simple conjunction fits the enumerative style.
Restores “Life” and provides the hinge into the third term of the triad. Keeps the impersonal, list-like structure of the substrate.

fills.fill: and in it they are established
fills.notes: The ship of living waters is another vessel-degree; the triad is said to “exist in” it. The substrate regularly adds a stabilizing clause (established, fixed) to indicate equilibrium within a degree.

fills.fill: is the Mind of the Father
fills.notes: The next line already gives “the happiness … the Mind of the Father.” The lacuna after “the happiness” needs exactly this identification to complete the triad mapping for this vessel.
Accepted as-is: in the ultimate degree (elements), blessedness is the stabilizing manifested Human-form (“Perfect Man”), i.e., the Pillar that supports the whole.
Accepted as-is: wisdom in ultimates is an arranged sufficiency of operative truths, traditionally enumerated as five sons proceeding from the Living Spirit.

Removes the editorial hesitation and restores a direct identification: power here is not vague but specifically the ‘five sons of the First Man’ as combatant goods in the first engagement with Darkness.
The syntax requires a resumptive demonstrative before the relative clause: “these, who are enclosed…” This keeps the impersonal listing style of the oldest layer.
The enclosed and compounded powers serve preservation of the totality in ultimates. “may not be broken” matches the spiritual sense: support and preserve the system under the weight of ultimates.

assessment: Most lacunae are short and tightly constrained by the chapter’s fixed triadic correspondential scheme across discrete degrees (Father, sun-ship of fire, water-ship, elements). The larger gaps were restored by preserving the emanation-and-containment logic: wisdom as proceeding understanding that descends and flows through aeons, and power as organized arrays of derived forces, culminating in the five combatant sons enclosed in the totality for preservation. A few medium gaps (¶4 #2–4, ¶5 #5, ¶5 #7–8, ¶7 #3) remain moderately constrained because multiple substrate-appropriate phrasings could express the same correspondential function.
